overlap_rules: Reconstructed right arm parts remain behind the shield; never paint them over the shield face.
The shield must remain a single uninterrupted foreground layer with no neighboring pixels.
Upper-arm and forearm cutouts need hidden overlap beneath the pauldron and shield so rotation never exposes transparent seams.
Pelvis backfill must extend beneath both thigh roots and the waist skirt.
Boot layers overlap shin layers by the joint cover area; do not split exactly at the visible armor seam.
acceptance_checks: Every reconstruction region has an authored transparent PNG and a matching source-resolution preview.
No transparent holes appear at shoulder, elbow, wrist, hip, knee or ankle through a full 20-degree rotation test.
Shield stays in front of the right arm through idle, attack, hit and cast.
No semantic clothing mask is accepted as an anatomical limb without visual boundary review.
A human visual review approves original-vs-layer composite at iPhone portrait scale.
blockers: No reconstructed pixel art exists yet for the hidden right arm, hand or pelvis.
Existing polygon and semantic masks are candidate masks only.
No production Warden rig manifest may be generated until all critical regions pass acceptance checks.
